type.name: DeepSeek Harness
type.description: DeepSeek's agent harness (dsh) and its web UI, installed with npm on a Node.js of its own (or one of yours), with its own npm configuration and dsh home.

parameters.versionHelp: An npm dist-tag (latest, next, alpha) or an exact version such as 0.2.2.
parameters.nodeVersionHelp: A major version (24), lts, latest, or an exact version such as 24.9.1; an update picks the newest release it names. dsh needs Node.js 24.9.0 or later. Not used when Node.js is one of yours.
parameters.homeHelp: Where dsh keeps its profiles, logins and sessions: in this instance (dsh-home and agents-home in its folder), or the ~/.dsh and ~/.agents every other dsh on this computer shares.

settings.npmRegistryHelp: The registry installs and the version list use, such as https://registry.npmmirror.com. Empty: https://registry.npmjs.org.
settings.nodeMirrorHelp: Where Node.js releases are downloaded from, such as https://cdn.npmmirror.com/binaries/node. Empty: https://nodejs.org/dist.

issues.version: Use an npm dist-tag (latest, next, alpha) or an exact version such as 0.2.2.
issues.nodeVersion: Use a major version (24 or later), lts, latest, or an exact version such as 24.9.1.

frame.nodeVersionHelp: A major version (24), lts, latest, or an exact version. An update picks the newest release it names.
frame.nodeUnmanaged: This DeepSeek Harness is installed with npm --global in a Node.js of yours. Switching runs that Node's npm; Hanafubuki never changes the Node.js itself, and never deletes it with the instance.
frame.confirmHint: Switching reinstalls dsh with npm; Hanafubuki asks you to confirm first.
frame.started: The update started; its progress is the instance's.
frame.unsupported: This version of Hanafubuki cannot update an instance from this page. Change the version in the instance's Maintenance section.
frame.running: Stop the instance before switching versions.
frame.nodePrefix: Uses the system's Node.js and dsh ({prefix}).
frame.nodeExternal: This instance runs your own Node.js ({path}). Hanafubuki never downloads into it or changes it; choose the managed Node.js in the instance's Paths to let Hanafubuki manage one.
frame.homeHint: Changing the home reinstalls dsh with npm. The instance's own home starts without the logins and sessions of ~/.dsh.
frame.copyHomeHint: Copies your ~/.dsh and ~/.agents (profiles, logins, sessions) into this instance's home; nothing is moved, and files already there are kept.

notices.nodeUnreadable: The Node.js you chose does not answer `--version`: {program}. Choose a folder whose bin/node (node.exe on Windows) runs, or the managed Node.js, in the instance's Paths.
notices.nodeOwnTooOld: The Node.js you chose is {version} ({program}); dsh needs 24.9.0 or later. Choose a newer one, or the managed Node.js, in the instance's Paths.
notices.npmMissing: The Node.js you chose ({program}) has no npm at {npm}, where its own npm lies in a Node.js release. Choose one with its npm, or the managed Node.js, in the instance's Paths.
notices.copyStarted: Copying ~/.dsh and ~/.agents into the instance's home. Files it already has are kept.
notices.copyDone: Copied {count} files from ~/.dsh and ~/.agents into the instance's home.
notices.copyFailed: Copying ~/.dsh into the instance's home failed: {error}
notices.copyRunning: Stop the instance before copying ~/.dsh into it.
notices.copyNothing: There is no ~/.dsh or ~/.agents to copy.
notices.copyBusy: ~/.dsh is already being copied into this instance.
notices.copySkipped: {count} could not be copied (a link Windows does not let it make, or a file in use) and were left out.
